description: Every METAR observation for one airport over the last N hours (up to 30 days), decoded and oldest first, plus a summary of the high and low temperature, strongest gust, flight-category low point and the weather reported. For checking what actually happened at a station: rain, gusts, fog, when it cleared. Source: NOAA/NWS Aviation Weather Center. The API returns at most 400 reports per call (about 8 days at half-hourly stations); not for flight planning. (cost: 1 credit)

hours.description: integer, optional, hours back from now, 1-720, default 24

icao.description: string, required, one ICAO station code (e.g. EGLC)

limit.description: integer, optional, most recent reports to list, 1-100, default 50 (the summary always covers the whole window)

name: metar_history
